build.//demo: APK for the DEMO instance. `preview` has no env block, so it falls through to extra.apiUrl and points at PRODUCTION — that is deliberate and must stay. This profile overrides the API at build time (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL wins over extra.apiUrl in services/api.ts) and turns on the one-tap demo login. Its OWN channel, so an OTA published for the prod-pointing preview build can never land on a demo handset. EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO_PASSWORD is NOT here: it lives as an EAS project variable, because this file is public.
